text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending overnight on-street permit parking be permitted on both sides of Rhodes Avenue, between Gerrard Street East and Fairford Avenue. The proposed amendment will increase the number of available on-street parking spaces while maintaining the one-way traffic flow on Rhodes Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing parking prohibition in effect from the first day to the 15th day of each month from April 1 to November 30, inclusive, on the west side of Rhodes Avenue, between a point 43.5 metres south of the north end of Rhodes Avenue and the lane first north of Gerrard Street East to be in effect between Fairford Avenue and a point 43.5 metres south of the north end of Rhodes Avenue. 2. Amended the existing parking prohibition in effect from the 16th day to the last day of each month from April 1 to November 30, inclusive, on the east side of Rhodes Avenue, between the north end of Rhodes Avenue and the lane first north of Gerrard Street East to be in effect between Fairford Avenue and the north end of Rhodes Avenue. 3.
